g.text: Formal scope: 200,000 coherent pairs, 400,000 ordered output pairs, 1,000,000 all-index regressions, 20/20 checks; exact integer audit. The plotted heat curve is presentation data for an analytic identity.

text.style: font-size: 3.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'Times', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b675f

g.text: Conclusion: signed fixed-output aggregation, exchange symmetrization, one-shell localization, and instantaneous heat evolution do not force decay. This is not a Duhamel estimate or a Navier–Stokes regularity proof.
